title: Concept: ELMAH error log disclosed
description: The ELMAH error log is served at this endpoint, so stored exception records with their request paths and captured form values are readable.
applicability: Responses served by an ASP.NET application with ELMAH enabled.
risk: The log names failing routes and exception types and each entry carries the request form values, which often include credentials; MEDIUM because the log must be opened to reach those values.
